source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.14 with Figures 10.5 and 10.6 and Quick Check 10.6, printed pages 227-228.

blocks.text: Teen bare qism ke half-cells hain jin ki E° value SHE se jor kar maloom ki ja sakti hai:

Figure 10.5 dikhati hai ke Cu²⁺/Cu half-cell ki E° value kaise napi jati hai. Cu²⁺/Cu half-cell ko SHE se jor kar voltage napa jata hai: +0.34 V. Copper cell ka positive terminal (positive pole) aur SHE negative terminal hai. Dono half-equations yeh hain:

blocks.alt: Cu2+/Cu half-cell standard hydrogen electrode se jura hua. Baen beaker: Cu2+ (1 mol/dm3) mein copper rod (Cu), terminal +. Daen beaker: hydrogen electrode, H2 (g) 1 atm, H+ (1 mol/dm3) aur platinum, terminal -. Salt bridge dono solutions ko jorta hai, darja hararat 298 K, aur taar par voltmeter 0.34 V dikhata hai; taar par teer hydrogen electrode se copper rod ki taraf hain aur dono siron par e- likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.5: Cu2+/Cu half-cell ka standard electrode potential naapna (kitab ki Figure 10.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Copper wala hissa positive (+) aur SHE negative (−) terminal hai, is liye electrons bahar ki taar mein SHE se copper ki taraf behte hain aur wahan Cu²⁺ ko Cu banate hain. Kitab ki figure mein taar par teer ulti taraf (copper se SHE) bane hain; electrons hamesha negative se positive terminal ki taraf jate hain, is liye hum ne teer sahi simt mein banaye hain.

E° values batati hain ke Cu²⁺ ions H⁺ ions se zyada aasani se reduce hote hain (un ki E° value zyada positive hai). Cu²⁺ ions ke electrons lene ka imkan H⁺ se zyada hai. Is liye Cu²⁺ ions H⁺/H₂ half-cell se electrons lete hain aur H₂ Cu²⁺/Cu half-cell ko electrons deti hai.

Figure 10.6 dikhati hai ke Zn²⁺/Zn half-cell ki E° value kaise napi jati hai. Zn²⁺/Zn half-cell ka voltage −0.76 V hai. Zinc metal negative terminal (negative pole) aur hydrogen electrode positive terminal hai.

E° values batati hain ke Zn²⁺ ions H⁺ ions se mushkil se reduce hote hain (un ki E° value zyada negative hai). Zn²⁺ ke electrons lene ka imkan H⁺ se kam hai. Is liye Zn H⁺/H₂ half-cell ko electrons deta hai aur H⁺ ions Zn²⁺/Zn half-cell se electrons lete hain.

blocks.alt: Zn2+/Zn half-cell standard hydrogen electrode se jura hua. Baen beaker: Zn2+ (1 mol/dm3) mein zinc rod (Zn), terminal -. Daen beaker: hydrogen electrode, H2 (g) 1 atm, H+ (1 mol/dm3) aur platinum, terminal +. Salt bridge, 298 K, aur voltmeter 0.76 V; taar ke dono siron par e- likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.6: Zn2+/Zn half-cell ka standard electrode potential naapna (kitab ki Figure 10.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: In do misalon se pata chalta hai ke:

items: Reduction cell ke positive terminal par hoti hai. Misal: Zn²⁺/Zn; H⁺/H₂ cell mein:
Oxidation cell ke negative terminal par hoti hai. Misal: Zn²⁺/Zn; H⁺/H₂ cell mein:

blocks.prompt: a) E° Cl₂/2Cl⁻ = +1.36 V, Br₂/2Br⁻ = +1.07 V aur I₂/2I⁻ = +0.54 V ki madad se wazahat karein: i) bromine iodide ions ko oxidize kar sakti hai; ii) bromine chloride ions se react kyun nahi karti?
blocks.explanation: E° jitna zyada positive, baen taraf ki species utni aasani se reduce hoti hai (utni taqatwar oxidizing agent). i) Br₂ (+1.07 V) I₂ (+0.54 V) se zyada positive hai, is liye Br₂ I⁻ se electrons le kar use I₂ mein oxidize kar deti hai: Br₂ + 2I⁻ → 2Br⁻ + I₂. ii) Cl₂ (+1.36 V) Br₂ se zyada positive hai, is liye Cl⁻ Br₂ ko electrons nahi deta; ulta chlorine bromide ko oxidize karti hai.

blocks.prompt: b) E° Ag⁺/Ag = +0.80 V, Cr²⁺/Cr = −0.91 V, Fe²⁺/Fe = −0.44 V. i) Ag⁺, Cr²⁺ aur Fe²⁺ mein sab se taqatwar aur sab se kamzor oxidizing agent kaun sa hai? ii) Ag, Cr aur Fe ko reducing power ki barhti tarteeb mein likhein.
blocks.explanation: i) Ag⁺ ki E° sab se positive hai, is liye woh sab se taqatwar oxidizing agent hai; Cr²⁺ ki sab se negative, is liye woh sab se kamzor. ii) E° jitna zyada negative, metal utna taqatwar reducing agent: Ag < Fe < Cr.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke Quick Check 10.6 b (i) mein ions “Cr₂+ aur Fe₂⁺” chhape hain; sahi Cr²⁺ aur Fe²⁺ hain.

items: Half-cell ki qismein: metal/ion (Cu²⁺/Cu), non-metal/ion (Cl₂/Cl⁻), ion/ion (Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺).
SHE ke saath: Cu²⁺/Cu +0.34 V (copper positive pole); Zn²⁺/Zn −0.76 V (zinc negative pole).
Reduction positive terminal par, oxidation negative terminal par.
